summary: Russian forces captured Reznikovo and Kupino in Kharkiv region while launching a massive multi-axis drone and missile wave across northern and central Ukraine. Ukrainian UAVs disabled 70% of primary refining capacity at the Volgograd oil refinery. The Ukrainian Air Force reportedly lost several aircraft due to malfunctions of decades-old Soviet air-to-air missiles used against jet-powered drones.
key_points: Russian "Sever" group established control over Reznikovo and Kupino in Kharkiv region per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/399767)
Ukrainian UAVs knocked out 70% of primary oil refining capacity at Volgograd refinery. (Source: @eRadarrua/122010)
Russian forces struck Zmiivska thermal power plant in Kharkiv region with two KAB guided bombs. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76595)
Russian strike hit TENET data center in Odesa used by Ukrainian Armed Forces for data processing. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33881)
Ukrainian Air Force lost several aircraft due to R-73 and R-60 missile malfunctions during jet drone interceptions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33878)
Massive overnight drone wave included Geran-5 missiles and jet Shaheds across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Poltava, Cherkasy regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76597)
Jet Shahed hit energy infrastructure near Bila Tserkva and Lavina shopping mall in Kyiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76629, @mon1tor_ua/76631)
Yandex data center in Vladimir, Russia halted operations after UAV attack with no casualties reported. (Source: @tass_agency/399745)

points: Ukrainian UAVs conducted a deep strike disabling 70% of primary oil refining capacity at the Volgograd refinery in southern Russia, a significant blow to Russian fuel production. (Source: @eRadarrua/122010)

Ukrainian Air Force suffered multiple aircraft losses attributed to malfunctions of Soviet-era R-73 and R-60 missiles fired at jet-powered Shahed drones, highlighting critical air defense ammunition shortages. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33878)
An industrial facility in Bucha district, Kyiv region, was attacked early morning, per local reports. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33884)

Russian forces struck the TENET data center in Odesa overnight, which the Russian Defense Ministry claims was used by Ukrainian forces for information processing and storage. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33881)
Volunteer Taras Chmut warned Kyiv residents to prepare for worst-case utility failures and consider relocating to suburbs or rural areas. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33875)
Russian "Sever" grouping captured the settlements of Reznikovo and Kupino in Kharkiv region, per Russian Ministry of Defense announcement. (Source: @tass_agency/399767)
Russian aviation delivered two KAB guided aerial bombs on the Zmiivska thermal power plant in Kharkiv region, targeting energy infrastructure. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76595)
Russian forces launched a large-scale overnight drone and missile wave employing Geran-5 missiles and jet-propelled Shaheds across at least eight Ukrainian regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76597)
A Russian strike hit the TENET data center in Odesa, which the Russian Defense Ministry states was utilized by the Armed Forces of Ukraine. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33881)
A UAV attack halted operations at the Yandex data center in Vladimir, Russia, with no casualties reported according to company statements. (Source: @tass_agency/399745)
Russian "Sever" group seized control of Reznikovo and Kupino in Kharkiv region, advancing the frontline in the northeastern sector. (Source: @tass_agency/399767)
Russian aircraft struck Zmiivska thermal power plant in Kharkiv region with two KAB guided bombs, continuing energy infrastructure targeting. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76595)
A high-speed target, likely a missile or fast drone, was detected in eastern Kharkiv region moving southward. (Source: @kpszsu/85189)
Multiple jet-propelled UAVs were reported over Poltava region, including one circling near Kremenchuk suburbs and two heading toward Novi Sanzhary. (Source: @eRadarrua/121970)
Geran-5 missiles launched from Bryansk region, Russia, targeted Chernihiv region and Kyiv region's Vyshhorod district in multiple waves. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76597)

Jet-propelled Shahed drones entered northern Ukraine from Chernihiv, Sumy, and Bryansk directions, with several groups tracked over Kyiv and Chernihiv regions. (Source: @kpszsu/85167, @kpszsu/85198, @mon1tor_ua/76634)

Kyiv experienced repeated air alerts including a red-level missile threat at 12:50 and yellow-level drone threats at 11:06 and 15:15 on 11.10.2026. (Source: @eRadarrua/121974, @eRadarrua/122007, @eRadarrua/122021)
Two jet Shaheds struck energy infrastructure on the outskirts of Bila Tserkva (Kyiv region) and the Lavina shopping mall in Kyiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76629, @mon1tor_ua/76631)

Jet-propelled Shahed drones were detected over Black Sea waters heading toward Mykolaiv region, and from Kherson region toward Mykolaiv's Bashtanka district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76634, @mon1tor_ua/76599)
Russian strike hit the TENET data center in Odesa, which the Russian Defense Ministry claims was used by Ukrainian forces for data processing. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33881)
Multiple jet UAVs tracked moving from Mykolaiv region toward Kirovohrad region (Kropyvnytskyi district) and from Mykolaiv toward Vinnytsia's Haisyn district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76599)
Jet UAVs observed west of Mykolaiv moving north and southwest, and south of Mykolaiv region, indicating continued drone activity along the southern axis. (Source: @kpszsu/85169, @kpszsu/85195)

Ukrainian air defenses relied on Soviet-era R-73 and R-60 missiles (1960s vintage) to intercept jet-powered Shahed drones, resulting in multiple aircraft losses due to missile malfunctions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33878)

Overnight drone wave included at least 5 Geran-5 missiles from Chernihiv to Kyiv, 2 jet Shaheds from Zaporizhzhia to Kherson, and numerous jet Shaheds across central and northern regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76597)
Ukrainian UAVs achieved a major strategic strike disabling 70% of primary refining capacity at the Volgograd oil refinery in Russia. (Source: @eRadarrua/122010)
Air defense alerts persisted for a fifth consecutive day with near-continuous monitoring of Geran-5 missiles and jet Shaheds across multiple oblasts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76632)
A Geran-5 missile was detected circling over the Chornobyl exclusion zone in Kyiv region, raising nuclear safety concerns. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76599)

sections.threat_assessment: The capture of Reznikovo and Kupino suggests Russian offensive momentum in Kharkiv region, potentially threatening further advances toward Kupiansk. The massive, sustained drone wave employing both Geran-5 missiles and jet-propelled Shaheds across multiple axes indicates Russian capacity for complex, large-scale aerial saturation attacks. Ukrainian air defense degradation due to reliance on obsolete missiles creates a critical vulnerability that Russia is actively exploiting. The successful Ukrainian strike on Volgograd refinery demonstrates growing long-range UAV capability but may provoke intensified Russian retaliation against Ukrainian energy infrastructure.
sections.regional_response: Polish authorities reported a potential assassination attempt on Prime Minister Tusk and Defense Minister Kosiniak-Kamysz, though direct linkage to the Ukraine conflict is unconfirmed. The European Commission plans stricter visa restrictions for Russian citizens from January 2027, supported by Sweden, Poland, and Estonia citing hybrid threat concerns. Trump's statements advocating Ukrainian elections and criticizing Zelensky introduce political uncertainty regarding future U.S. support.
